With all the anti google sentiment, is there a better search engine?

I really like DuckDuckGo, specifically for it's 'bang notation'

With it, I can do things like "!gh voat" to search github for voat or "!yt kttens" to search youtube for kittens or "!wa number of US presidents" to ask wolfram alpha how many US presidents there have been.

the short answer? probably not - google, bing and yahoo are the top dogs (at least in the u.s.) and most other so-called search engines use their indexes

the longer answer...

it depends what you're trying to achieve -- if you are wanting to circumvent the privacy issues associated with google, but are willing to use their indexes, then DuckDuckGo and Startpage are both good as others have mentioned, as well as Disconnect which gives you a choice as to what index you want to search

if you're wanting to circumvent censorship, check out Good Gopher, which apparently has its own crawlers - i just recently found this one, so i'm not too sure how good it is yet - as well as the Internet Archive and archive.is

No, Google is the best without a doubt. You'll have to make a compromise if you want to use an alternative. There are ways to search Google anonymously, like the !g syntax in DuckDuckGo, or Startpage.
